settings.heading: Before you ask
settings.questions:
Do these actually work? I’ve heard they don’t.
£59 is a lot for a tube.
How long does it take to work?
Will it fit my brand of balls?
What if I don’t like it?
settings.answers:
Most don’t — they leak slowly and you never find out. That is why the gauge is on the cap. More than 1 PSI lost in 30 days and we replace it free.
It is about seven cans of balls. Most players on court twice a week spend that in four months.
Balls hold pressure from the moment you seal the tube. Already-soft balls need 24–48 hours to come back up.
It fits all standard padel and tennis balls. Capacity is four; a standard can is three, so you have room for a spare.
Thirty days, full refund. Return it unused in its box and keep the overgrips.

settings.heading: We measure it so you don’t have to trust us
settings.body:
Every tube is pressure-tested before it ships. If yours loses more than 1 PSI over 30 days, email us a photo of the gauge and we will replace it — no return needed, no argument.

That promise only works because the gauge exists. It is the reason the product is shaped this way.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: Dispatched within one working day. UK delivery is 2–3 working days, tracked. EU is 4–7 working days.

settings.question: Do you ship outside the UK?
settings.answer: Yes — EU, Ireland, and on request elsewhere. EU orders are shipped with duties prepaid, so nothing is collected on your doorstep.

settings.question: How do returns work?
settings.answer: Thirty days from delivery. Email us and we send a label. Refund within five working days of it reaching us.
